messages:
maya: quick alert 1: demand model bumped EU capacity needs; looks like ~95 H100s short for June launch. need vendor sync on lead times + RMA pool today.
lia: on it. do we have carrier pricing from last quarter to reuse? also need customs owner for expedited invoices.
tony_vendor: morning 60tony here60. factory schedule: sea 56w, air consolidation 1014 days. air premium roughly $9001k per GPU (ballpark) for 20-unit pallet; actual depends on AWB lanes. RMA throughput: we can commit 15 refurb units/week max out of the depot.
oliver: infra question  if we accept mixed batches (new + RMA refurb) do we need separate node pools? our tagging expects firmware parity. mixing could cause scheduler churn.
sam_ops: we can quarantine RMAs into "staging-rma" namespace and run a firmware alignment job before joining production. adds ~36h of ops work per batch.
ben: ops checklist note: thermal soak + burn-in mandatory for RMAs. recommend 72h thermal soak, 48h burn-in tests (power cycle, mem-check, perf microbench). add separate monitoring alerting rule for RMA cohort.
sre-bot: INFO: eu-staging cluster thermal baseline: 1.4% warning rate. last refurbished batch: +3.8% spike. recommend extended soak.
maya: numbers: lost ARR if delay = est $60k/week. air for first 40 units ~ $40k50k depending on surcharges; sea is free-ish but 6w delay. need ROI.
lia: quick calc: option A (sea): 0 expedite cost, launch delayed 6w -> ~ $360k lost. Option B (air for 40 + sea rest): expedite cost ~ $45k55k, reduces delay to 2w for initial units, net saved ~$300k. i'll formalize and route to finance.
tony_vendor: we can split invoices to mark refurbished discount for customs. HS code for GPUs is 8471.60, but customs agent prefers full description to avoid hold. buyer-signed CI required for air.
oliver: deployment-side: if we do hybrid, reserve 30 GPUs for p99-critical services. we'll drain batch nodes during install:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-###
./install-drivers.sh && ./run-burnin.sh
kubectl uncordon gpu-node-###
```
ben: ops staffing: 3 engineers for parallel installs over 10 days if staggered shipments. expect overtime during week 1.
sam_ops: timeline ask for Tony: per-shipment ETA + provisional AWB so we can book customs broker ahead.
tony_vendor: will send per-shipment ETAs by EOD and tentative AWBs within 24h. note: third air booking in same billing week triggers peak surcharge (~12%).
maya: ok action list: 1) Lia finalize ROI + PO amendment (EOD). 2) Tony send ETAs/AWBs (24h). 3) Ben publish RMA burn-in checklist + alert rules (today). 4) Oliver post deploy gating doc and reserve 30 GPUs (2h). 5) Sam book provisional customs broker hold once AWB in. reconvene after ROI posted.
lia: amending PO to allow split shipments, expedited clause, HS code & CI requirement. will CC finance after ROI.
ben: publishing checklist now, will include thermal thresholds, commands, and Slack alert hook.
sre-bot: NOTE: please tag #incidents if thermal event >5% across cohort during burn-in.
maya: thanks team. pref air-first 40, rest sea if ROI supports. Tony, if you can enable expedited manifest splitting (new vs RMA), that helps ops.
tony_vendor: confirmable. i'll try to push new units on earlier air window. will post updates.
maya: end.
